SearchAliases: carefree letting things take their course
Senses.Explanation: Carefree, letting things take their course describes an unforced way of going through ordinary life. Tengteng's song places both word orders beside morning gruel, the midday meal, clear inward knowledge, and an outwardly simple appearance. Yuanwu Keqin couples the phrase with being thoroughly ordinary. Gaofeng Yuanmiao uses the reversible pair for someone with no household property to return to and nothing named Chan to learn, while Feiyin Tongrong makes it the opening movement of a deliberately unruly saying. These uses support a rhythmic description of conduct without turning it into a prescribed procedure.
